items.note: Not stated: why the other three do not (trapping needs a high-NA objective, but that reason is not the person's statement and is not recorded as theirs), which of 40x WI and any other 40x is meant (the store's 40x is the water-immersion MRD77400), or whether a trap was ever tried at 20x. For limits: position limits are wanted only for these three objectives, and a missing row means software refuses every trap command at any other objective.
